newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES JUMP 2.21PCT IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES JUMP 2.21PCT IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: Greek stocks jumped 2.21 percent on Monday on subdued trading volume -- a broadly based upswing in prices. Brokers attributed the market's performance to easing selling pressure coupled with selective buying.

"There is no particular reason for the cumulative rise of around 4.0 percent since Friday as the news hitting the market on the macro and the corporate front were fully anticipated," said Thanos Trikatzis, a broker at Hermes Brokerage.
June CPI inflation, officially released on Friday, edged up to 5.5 percent from 5.4 percent in May.

"On the bid side, there is some discrete interest by investors with a medium-term horizon," he added. "Careful stock-pickers will be rewarded, but they will probably have to be patient until trading activity picks up again after the end of the vacation season."
The Athens general index advanced 2.21 percent or 33.46 points to 1,547.64 from Friday's 1,504.80, closing near the day's high of 1,543.90.
Banks and industrials added 2.48 percent with all sub-indices posting a rise.
Turnover was subdued, reaching 8.8 billion drachmas on volume of 2.7 million shares.
Blocks were traded in Aegek, 275,000 shares at 1,510 drachmas, and Naousa Spinning, 120,000 shares at 1,350.
Advancers beat decliners 138 to 67 with 25 shares unchanged on 230 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted at London's SEAQ International market at $11.50-$11.80. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas, capped at 5,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,115-1,145 drachmas.

The recently launched second Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 6,800 drachmas, capped at 10,000 drachmas, was quoted at 1,135-1,195 drachmas. The warrants expire December 16, 1998. Shares of the underlying stock firmed 80 drachmas to 6,515.
The Merrill Lynch American call warrant on a basket of 23 Greek equities that are part of the Athens general index was quoted at 573.70-610.32 drachmas. The warrants expire January 9 1998.

The ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $71.65-$74.43. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.

The ING Baring Financial Products American-style call warrant on a basket of six blue-chips denominated in drachmas was quoted at 3,340-3,560 drachmas. The strike price is set at 10,000 drachmas and the warrants expire on February 2, 1998.
The ING Baring American-style second call warrant on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted at $11.30-N/O. The strike price is set at $110.0 and the warrants expire April 9 1998.

The recently launched ING Baring American-style, drachma- denominated call warrant on the bourse's benchmark index was quoted at 213-244 drachmas. The strike price is set at 1,639 points and the warrants expire May 14 1998.
